strings.privacy:metadata: The Roles factor plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.settings:description: Select the roles that must use additional factors to authenticate. If this factor is not turned on, all roles will be required to use an additional factor.
strings.settings:roles_help: Select the roles that will not pass this factor. This allows you to force these roles to use other factors to authenticate.
strings.settings:shortdescription: Specify which users must use other factors to authenticate, based on their role. Must be combined with other factors.
strings.summarycondition: does NOT have any of the following roles assigned in any context: {$a}
